notes: Basalt "Gravity Anchor": a squat stone block with four iron intake grilles (it pulls air from the rooms next to it) round a ring of heavy iron holding a dark gravity core. On loop (4): the ring segments turn, the core pulses cyan and pale motes drift in toward it through the grilles. Damaged: one intake grille torn off, the ring chipped and out of true, the core flickering. Disabled: the core dark and cold, the ring split, the block cracked, a grille hanging.
